The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are now available for pre-order. Apple unveiled the two new phones on Wednesday, highlighting the variable aperture camera system, smaller Dynamic Island, four new colors, and more.

  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro (Apple website)
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro Max (Apple website)
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro (Walmart)
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro Max (Walmart)

The iPhone 18 Pro is now available for pre-order.

As a refresher, here are some of the headline features of the iPhone 18 Pro lineup:

  • A new variable aperture main camera for more flexibility with lighting and depth of field.
  • A new A20 Pro chip with 50% more memory bandwidth and 40% faster GPU performance.
  • The Dynamic Island has shrunk and can now show three Live Activities at once.
  • Battery life has gotten a major boost. The iPhone 18 Pro can last up to 24 hours in real-world use, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max can reach 30 hours.
  • A new vapor chamber design for more stable sustained performance.
  • Faster wired charging: 50% in 15 minutes.

The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max come in four colors:

  • Bordeaux
  • Glacier Blue
  • Silver
  • Black

The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at $1,299. Storage starts at 256GB and goes up to 2TB. You can pay in full, finance with Apple Card or a carrier, or opt for the new Apple Upgrade leasing program.

The first wave of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-orders will arrive next Friday, September 18. The next to go on sale will be the iPhone Duo, with pre-orders opening October 16 and shipping starting October 23.

Are you pre-ordering a new iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max? Or still holding out for the iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.
